verdict.rationale: Gram's CLI supports scripting deployments and toolset installs (gram-docs-21, gram-docs-30) and the MoonPay case shows scaling to 200+ servers in 30 days (gram-docs-9), suggesting some capacity for bulk onboarding/management, but there is no explicit bulk-operation feature (e.g., batch edit, mass tool invocation, bulk import UI) documented for end users. missing for 10: explicit bulk-action API/UI for managing or invoking many items at once, and independent confirmation of bulk workflows beyond the single case study.
